metadata.case_name: HO AH LOOK v. NAM KIN SCAFFOLDING LTD. AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: head injury (laceration on the forehead, abrasion on the nasal bridge)
source: he fell from the scaffold at a height of about 4.6 metres to the ground and thereby sustained head injury, fracture of the right femur and fracture of the superior pubic ramus of the pelvis.

As a result of the accident, he suffered a laceration on the forehead, abrasion on the nasal bridge, subtrochanteric fracture of the right femur and fracture of the superior pubic ramus of the pelvis.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: fracture of the superior pubic ramus of the pelvis
source: he fell from the scaffold at a height of about 4.6 metres to the ground and thereby sustained head injury, fracture of the right femur and fracture of the superior pubic ramus of the pelvis.
The fracture of the superior and inferior pubic ramus of the pelvis is now reasonably healed.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: subtrochanteric / comminuted fracture of the right femur (right thigh bone) with mal-union and right lower limb shortened by 3 cm
source: he fell from the scaffold at a height of about 4.6 metres to the ground and thereby sustained head injury, fracture of the right femur and fracture of the superior pubic ramus of the pelvis.

By way of a summary of the injuries suffered by the Plaintiff, Dr Chiang said that the Plaintiff suffered a comminuted fracture of the right thigh bone (femur) and that this was initially fixed by an implant of a nail into the whole femur.
A mal-union resulted in the right leg being shortened by 3 cm.
The range of movement at the right hip was restricted to just 30(. His right lower limb was shortened by 3 cm and he has to wear special shoes and walk with a mild limp.

injuries.description: infection in the wound, in the hip joint and inside the cavity of the femur bone
source: Complications arose because of infection in the wound, in the hip joint and inside the cavity of the femur bone.
Two further operations were performed on 17th and 24th March 1993 due to wound infection.
He had five operations but these did not include the operation he had in January 1999 which was necessitated by the infection of his wound.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: pain whilst walking; pain after walking for a long period and in bad weather
range of movement at the right hip was restricted to just 30(
right lower limb shortened by 3 cm
has to wear special shoes and walk with a mild limp
Plaintiff's capacity for daily activities and his endurance has been much decreased

treatments_received: reduction and fixation of the right femoral fracture with intra-medullary nail (operation on 26th February 1993)
revision of screws used for fixation (operation on 5th March 1993)
operations for wound infection (operations on 17th and 24th March 1993)
removal of the intra-medullary nail, debridement of the wound, reaming of the femur and insertion of gentamycin beads (operation on 20th December 1993)
wound cleansing at Violet Peel Health Centre

losses.description: 35% whole person impairment; mal-union of the right femur; right lower limb shortened by 3 cm; narrowing of the hip joint space
restricted range of movement at the right hip, pain whilst walking, wearing special shoes and walking with a mild limp
capacity for daily activities and endurance much decreased; pain on prolonged walking limits daily activities
unable to return to pre-injury job as a scaffolder; handicapped on the labour market; assessed 50% loss of earning capacity
